_comment: SYNTHETIC fixture — assembled from public Spreed source, not captured from a real server. Verify against real traffic in Task 2.3. Represents the response of GET /ocs/v2.php/apps/spreed/api/v4/call/{token} (CallController::getPeersForCall, apiVersion restricted to v4 — note: Call API is v4 while signaling API is v3). Returns the list of peers currently in the call (different from the usersInRoom list: this one is fetched once on join, contains no inCall flags, but includes displayName). Used to seed the peer-mesh before the first signaling pull. Anonymized: sessionId -> 'SESSION_1'..'SESSION_3'; actorId -> 'alice'/'bob'/'carol'; displayName -> 'Alice'/'Bob'/'Carol'; token -> 'tok-test-call'.
_spec_alignment: Spec 2026-07-19-nctalk-call-design.md §2 confirms GET /call/{token} returns actorType/actorId/displayName/sessionId/lastPing. Verified verbatim against source.
